Author: Valentina Vieri
Name: VieriNexus
Punchline: Routes, progression, and verified automation under one Nexus.
Description: The unified, modular Vieri suite in active development. Routes & Navigation owns streamlined route creation and playback through Lifestream and vnavmesh. Progression owns the level goal, protected gil floor, verified gear-readiness transaction, one-duty-at-a-time execution, Stop, recovery, and replanning while migration providers supply narrow mechanics.
